result.title: Separating Common and Unique Directions for Data-Free Model Merging
result.summary: Model merging combines multiple fine-tuned models without additional training, and arithmetic methods have emerged as a simple yet effective way to merge models without data. However, existing arithmetic methods treat task vectors in parameter space and apply a single element-wise rule to directions that can differ in mergeability. In a shared directional basis, we find a consistent two-regime structure: a low-dispersion common bulk shared across tasks and a high-dispersion task-dominated tail that carries disproportionate energy. These findings motivate Common--Unique Subspace Decomposition (CUSD), a data-free pre-merging method that separates task vectors into common and unique directional components, merges the common components with downstream arithmetic operator, and retains unique residuals separately. Experiments across $11$ base models, four model families, and four arithmetic-based merging operators show that CUSD improves 42 of 44 model--operator combinations and achieves up to 22.5% improvement over the corresponding baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/stwang666/CUSD

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无数据模型合并，发现共享方向基下任务向量呈「低离散度公共主体＋高离散度任务特有尾部」的双区制结构，并据此提出 CUSD：把任务向量拆成公共与唯一方向分量，前者用原算术算子合并、后者单独保留，在 11 个基模型、4 个模型族与 4 种算术合并算子上改善 42/44 组组合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按跨任务离散度分离公共与特有方向的分析工具，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态中共享内容方向与查询特异方向的分解与相似度解释；但该方法作用于权重空间任务向量而非推理期状态，联系需较多核查。
